ValidationRule.description: #24349: Validation to restrict users from entering Annual Amount above 50 M USD #30753: Opportunity: Add bypass logic to Amount_cannot_exceed_50MillionUSD VR for SOps users #31272: Opportunity: Handling & Permissioning of Opps w/ Total Annual Amount
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
OR( AND(ISCHANGED(Amount), Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) >= 50000000), AND( ISNEW(), Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) >= 50000000 )),
$Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission_Sales_Super_User) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Total Annual Amount cannot exceed $50 million by default. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
